svg.title: Association-rule support and confidence
svg.desc: Each point is a directed rule generated from a frequent itemset; green points satisfy every declared rule threshold.
svg.text: n=457 participant-days; 860 rules from itemsets of size 2-3; min support 5%, confidence 60%, lift 1.10, at least 5 participants
Interpretation: Eligibility additionally requires lift and distinct-participant support; a high confidence alone is insufficient.
Limitation: Rules are descriptive co-occurrences, not causal statements; repeated days from one person are not independent.
